yatthupapan‍nauti avihādīsu yattha yattha upapan‍nau| imaisaṃ pana anāgāmīnaṃ pabhaidajānanatthaṃ uddhaṃsautaakaniṭṭhagāmicatuk‍kaṃ vaiditabbaṃ – yau hi avihatau paṭṭhāya cattārau daivalaukai saudhaitvā akaniṭṭhaṃ gantvā parinibbāti, ayaṃ uddhaṃsautau akaniṭṭhagāmī nāma| yau pana haiṭṭhā tayau daivalaukai saudhaitvā sudassīdaivalaukai ṭhatvā parinibbāti, ayaṃ uddhaṃsautau naakaniṭṭhagāmī nāma| yau itau akaniṭṭhamaiva gantvā parinibbāti, ayaṃ nauddhaṃsautau akaniṭṭhagāmī nāma| yau pana haiṭṭhā catūsu daivalaukaisu tattha tatthaiva parinibbāti, ayaṃ nauddhaṃsautau naakaniṭṭhagāmī nāma| aitai pana avihaisu upapan‍nasamanantarā āyuvaimajjhaṃ appatvā, patvā ca parinibbāyanavasaina tayau antarāparinibbāyinau, aikau upahac‍caparinibbāyī, aikau uddhaṃsautauti pañ‍ca| tai asaṅkhārasasaṅkhāraparinibbāyivibhāgaina dasa haunti| tathā atappasudassasudassīsūti cattārau dasakā cattālīsaṃ| akaniṭṭhai pana uddhaṃsautau natthi| tayau antarāparinibbāyinau, aikau upahac‍caparinibbāyīti cattārau| tai asaṅkhārasasaṅkhāraparinibbāyivibhāgaina aṭṭhāti aṭṭhacattālīsaṃ anāgāminau|

sautāpan‍nā pana paṭipadābhaidaina cattārau sattakkhattuparamā, cattārau kaulaṃkaulā, cattārau aikabījinauti saddhādhuraina paṭipan‍nā dvādasa, tathā pañ‍ñādhuraināti catuvīsati|

sakadāgāminau suñ‍ñatavimaukkhaina vimuttā paṭipadāvasaina cattārau, tathā animittaappaṇihitavimaukkhaihīti dvādasa|

889. tathā arahantau| tai pana dvādasa pañ‍ñāvimuttā, dvādasa ubhataubhāgavimuttā, dvādasa taivij‍jā, dvādasa chaḷabhiñ‍ñā, dvādasa paṭisambhidāppattāti  samasaṭṭhi haunti| aivamaitai saddhiṃ pac‍caikasambuddhasammāsambuddhaihi chacattālīsādhikasataṃ ariyā| yasmā taisaṃ ariyabhāvasiddhi ariyāya pañ‍ñābhāvanāya, taina vuttaṃ ‘‘āhunaiyyabhāvādisiddhipi imissā laukuttarapañ‍ñābhāvanāya ānisaṃsau’’ti| laukiyavij‍jābhiñ‍ñāhi vināpi ubhataubhāgavimuttatā hautīti  ubhataubhāgavimuttau visuṃ gahitau| yaṃ sandhāya vuttanti yaṃ catutthamaggapañ‍ñābhāvanaṃ sandhāya haiṭṭhā saṅkhaipatau gāthāvaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ pana vuttākāraṃ nigamanavasaina dassaituṃ ‘‘maggakkhaṇai’’tiādi vuttaṃ| kāmaṃ catūsupi maggakkhaṇaisu taṃ jaṭaṃ vijaṭaiti nāma, phalakkhaṇaisupi yathārahaṃ vijaṭitajaṭau, aggaphalakkhaṇaiyaiva pana sabbasau vijaṭitajaṭau, tatau paraṃ vijaṭaitabbāya jaṭāya abhāvatau| tainaittha haiṭṭhā haiṭṭhimamaggapañ‍ñābhāvanānisaṃsassa vuttattāva catutthamaggapañ‍ñābhāvanāvasaina atthau vuttau|

ratinti abhiratiṃ, abhirucinti atthau| tatthāti ariyāya pañ‍ñābhāvanāya|

890. imissā gāthāyāti imissaṃ gāthāyaṃ| gāthā hi attanau atthabhūtassa visuddhimaggassa ādhārabhāvaina vuttā, sāmivacanaṃ vā aitaṃ atthassa taṃsambandhibhāvatau|

pañ‍ñābhāvanānisaṃsaniddaisavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

iti taivīsatimaparicchaidavaṇṇanā|

nigamanakathāvaṇṇanā

891. imissā  dāni gāthāyātiādīnaṃ gāthānaṃ atthau haiṭṭhā vuttau aiva| svāyaṃ ‘‘visuddhimaggaṃ bhāsissa’’nti aivaṃ paṭiñ‍ñātau visuddhimaggau aittāvatā bhāsitau hautīti sambandhau|

892. tatthātiādīsu ayaṃ padasambandhaina saddhiṃ saṅkhaipatthau – taisaṃ ‘‘sīlai patiṭṭhāyā’’tigāthāyaṃ vuttānaṃ sīlādippabhaidānaṃ atthānaṃ pañ‍can‍nampi mahānikāyānaṃ aṭṭhakathānayai aṭṭhakathātantiyaṃ tattha tattha vuttau yau vinicchayau, yaibhuyyaina taṃ sabbaṃ samāharitvā samānaitvā nikāyantarassa nikāyagatavādadausasaṅkaraihi muttau sau nicchayau yasmā pakāsitau, tasmā visuddhikāmaihi yaugīhi aitasmiṃ visuddhimaggai ādarau karaṇīyauyaivāti|

nigamanagāthāyau

aittāvatā  ca –

suvisuddhasamācārau, visuddhanayamaṇḍitaṃ|

visuddhimaggaṃ laukassa, yadac‍cantavisuddhiyā||

abhāsi karuṇāvaiga-samussāhitamānasau|

mahaisi vipulaudāta-visuddhimatipāṭavau||

tassa atthaṃ pakāsaituṃ, kathāmaggaṃ purātanaṃ|

nissāya yā samāraddhā, atthasaṃvaṇṇanā mayā||

āyācitau siddhagāma-parivaiṇanivāsinā|

thairaina dāṭhanāgaina, suddhācāraina dhīmatā||

sā aisā paramatthānaṃ, tattha tattha yathārahaṃ|

nidhānatau paramattha-mañ‍jūsā nāma nāmatau||

sampattā pariniṭṭhānaṃ, anākulavinicchayā|

aṭṭhāsītippamāṇāya, pāḷiyā bhāṇavāratau||

iti taṃ saṅkharauntaina, yaṃ taṃ adhigataṃ mayā|

puñ‍ñaṃ tassānubhāvaina, laukanāthassa sāsanai||

augāhaitvā visuddhāya, sīlādipaṭipattiyā|

sabbaipi daihinau hauntu, vimuttirasabhāginau||

ciraṃ  tiṭṭhatu laukasmiṃ, sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ|

tasmiṃ sagāravā nic‍caṃ, hauntu sabbaipi pāṇinau||

sammā vassatu kālaina, daivau rājā mahīpati|

saddhammaniratau laukaṃ, dhammainaiva pasāsatūti||

badaratitthavihāravāsinā ācariyadhammapālaina katā

paramatthamañ‍jūsā nāma visuddhimaggamahāṭīkā samattā|

visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā samattā|
